primary_hypothesis.name: extreme_isolation_topology_regime_switch
primary_hypothesis.statement: After a strong ecological reference is supplied, the incremental held-out effect of a species-conditioned structural coordinate is more favourable in the upper 25% of a response-independent isolation distribution than in the remaining eligible units.
primary_hypothesis.increment_definition: candidate held-out loss minus strong-reference held-out loss; negative is favourable
primary_hypothesis.extreme_isolation_rule: upper 25% of the frozen eligible-unit isolation distribution computed from predictor-only data before response access
primary_hypothesis.primary_contrast: mean candidate-minus-reference loss in extreme-isolation units minus mean candidate-minus-reference loss in non-extreme units

predeclared_robustness.role: directional sensitivity only; the 0.75 threshold remains primary
predeclared_robustness.success_rule: robustness thresholds cannot rescue a failed primary 0.75 contrast

secondary_moderation_hypothesis.name: source_saturation_relief
secondary_moderation_hypothesis.statement: The extreme-isolation improvement becomes more favourable as pre-response species source/range breadth increases.
secondary_moderation_hypothesis.test: continuous standardized breadth x extreme-isolation interaction on candidate-minus-reference held-out loss
secondary_moderation_hypothesis.breadth_definition: a response-independent source/range breadth measure frozen before confirmatory response access

secondary_state_diagnostic.name: presence_penalty_attenuation
secondary_state_diagnostic.statement: If a regime switch exists, the candidate's excess loss on true presences should be smaller in extreme-isolation units than in non-extreme units.
secondary_state_diagnostic.expected_interaction_direction: observed_presence x extreme_isolation negative on candidate-minus-reference loss

minimum_components: process-aware or source-aware isolation appropriate to the system

transfer_requirement.cross_origin_generalization: requires same-direction primary regime-switch contrast in independently admitted island and fragmentation systems under spatial transfer

anti_selection: do not choose a system because exploratory extreme-tail results are already favourable
do not choose the isolation metric after future response access
do not move the primary 0.75 threshold after future response access
do not use 0.70 or 0.80 robustness thresholds to rescue a failed 0.75 primary
do not select taxa using candidate-minus-reference direction
do not promote source-breadth or observed-state diagnostics into the primary after outcome
do not count A-Islands or Tanzania discovery statistics as future confirmation
